title: Confessions of a Long-Distance Sailor
author: vinh
preview: In this book, you will follow Mr. Paul Lutus when he single-handled Selene around the world during the end of the eighties.
content: Through the book, you will experience a snapshot of the world in the nineties, from the west coast of the US to the Mediterranean Sea. You will fall in love with the sea worthiness of Selene, a Crealock 31 sailboat that specially designed for blue water sailing and enhanced with the most modern equipments that the time, unlike the bare minimum style of Pino, another sailboat that I follow for a long time. The book opened a new perspective about an independent and sustainable lifestyle.
